history.summary: This is a local Sai Baba shrine at Ujha Road, Ekta Vihar Colony, Panipat (pin 132104; contact 09215914789 per listings) — the best-documented Sai Baba temple in Panipat, with a dedicated travel-directory page. No published founding history, built date, or trust information found; modern neighbourhood temple. AMBIGUITY FLAG: a second Sai Baba Mandir exists at 382-L, Idgah Road, Panipat; this file documents the Ujha Road/Ekta Vihar one, which has the strongest map and directory presence. No festival calendar is specifically documented for this shrine (festival list intentionally left blank rather than inferred).

town_description: Panipat, on the GT Road about 90 km north of Delhi, is famous as the site of three decisive battles (1526, 1556, 1761) and is today a major textile and handloom hub. It became a separate district from Karnal on 31 October 1989.
